description: List the collections belonging to the Pexels account that owns the configured API key (paginated). Since Pexels has no per-conversation OAuth login, this always reflects the API key's own account, not the person chatting — it will be empty unless that account has created collections on pexels.com. Read-only.

per_page.description: Items per page (clamped to a max of 80).

name: pexels_list_my_collections
title: List My Pexels Collections
